title: Version and align Biggie canonical Command Center Lab with Smalls
description: Operator-directed 2026-07-29 follow-up: treat Biggie live /home/mellow/Projects/CommandCenterUI redesign as the desired CCL version, first import its exact stable source into the repo-owned installer template and add deterministic version/parity evidence, then align Smalls only after its exact host/device identity, clean destination state, backup, dry-run, and checksum match are established. Preserve RUKI MAP authority, host credentials/configuration, runtime state, and unrelated projects. This follows TASK-298 point-in-time convergence but does not extend its submitted evidence.
acceptance_criteria: The exact Biggie live canonical CCL file set and provenance are recorded; repo template source matches it byte-for-byte for managed program files, with host/runtime exclusions explicit and no credentials, map.db, authority configuration, hcom state, logs, caches, or unrelated Projects content included.

A deterministic version.json and checksum manifest identify the managed CCL bundle; validation fails on missing, changed, extra managed, or stale installed files while allowing only explicit host-local runtime exclusions.

The cross-PC protocol locks direction Biggie-to-Smalls, requires exact destination identity, clean-or-preserved destination changes, pre-write backup, dry-run review, staged checksum verification, atomic/recoverable activation, and post-deploy smoke/parity checks; it never changes MAP authority topology.
Smalls is not modified until its exact endpoint and user are confirmed and a dry-run proves scope; all remote writes use the approved administrative channel and preserve rollback evidence.

Focused automated tests pass, Biggie live/template parity is proven, Smalls installed parity and communication are proven after deployment, and a different core agent performs functional plus security-framed review before approval/release.
